title: GAP Waiver Addenda: How Many Addenda a Borrower and a Contract May Hold
content:
A GAP Waiver Addendum attaches to one retail installment contract.

**Rule.** A borrower may hold an addendum on each of their contracts, and there is no limit per borrower. A single contract never carries more than one addendum that is not closed; the plan schedule sets that per-contract maximum at 1.

| Holding | Allowed |
|---|---|
| One open addendum on each of a borrower's three contracts | yes, because there is no per-borrower limit |
| Two open addenda on the same contract | no, because a contract carries at most one addendum that is not closed |
| A new addendum on a contract whose earlier addendum is closed | the earlier addendum no longer counts toward the limit, since it is closed |

A borrower's count of addenda therefore never decides eligibility. Only the count of addenda that are not closed on the contract in question does.
